text.en: Which instruction does every Dockerfile start with?

explanation.tr: Taban imajı seçmeden başka bir şey yapılamıyor.
explanation.en: Nothing else can be done before choosing the base image.

text.en: What does `WORKDIR /app` do?

tr: /app klasörünü oluşturup sonraki talimatları orada çalıştırır
en: Creates the /app folder and runs the following instructions there
Deletes the /app folder on your computer
Starts the container in /app and stops it at once

explanation.en: Like `cd`, but it also creates the folder.

text.en: Without `WORKDIR`, where are files copied?

explanation.en: They get mixed with Linux's own folders.

text.en: In `COPY requirements.txt .`, where is `.` inside the image?

en: The working folder (set with WORKDIR, e.g. /app)
The project folder on your computer

explanation.en: The destination is inside the image; the source is in the context.

text.en: Where does `COPY` take the source file from?

en: From the build context (the folder given to docker build)

explanation.en: You cannot leave the context with `..`.

text.en: When does the `RUN` instruction run?

en: While the image is built (docker build)
Never; it is only a comment

explanation.en: Its result goes into the image as a layer.

text.en: When does the `CMD` instruction run?

explanation.en: The container's default command.

text.tr: `RUN python app.py` yazmak neden programı konteynerde çalıştırmaz?
text.en: Why does writing `RUN python app.py` not run the program in the container?

tr: Program imaj kurulurken bir kez çalışır; konteyner açılınca çalışacak olan CMD
en: The program runs once while the image is built; what runs when the container starts is CMD

explanation.en: The most common Dockerfile mistake.

text.tr: Dockerfile'da iki `CMD` satırı varsa hangisi geçerli olur?
text.en: If a Dockerfile has two `CMD` lines, which one counts?

explanation.en: The earlier ones are silently ignored.

text.en: How many `RUN` lines can a Dockerfile have?

explanation.en: Each adds a layer.

text.en: Why is `pip install --no-cache-dir` used?

tr: pip'in indirdiklerinin kopyasını imajda saklamaması için (daha küçük imaj)
en: So pip does not keep copies of what it downloads in the image (a smaller image)

explanation.tr: O önbellek imajda yalnızca yer kaplıyor.
explanation.en: That cache only takes up space in an image.

text.en: What is the `.` in `docker build -t greeter .`?

en: The build context: the folder sent to Docker

explanation.tr: COPY yalnızca bu klasörün içinden dosya alabiliyor.
explanation.en: COPY can only take files from inside this folder.

text.tr: `docker build -t greeter .` sonunda imaj hangi adla kaydedilir?
text.en: With `docker build -t greeter .`, under which name is the image saved?

explanation.en: `latest` is added because no tag was written.

text.en: What does `[3/5]` tell you in the build output?

en: The third of five build steps

explanation.en: Each instruction is a step (FROM included).

text.en: What does the error `"/app.pyy": not found` tell you?

tr: COPY'nin istediği dosya derleme bağlamında yok (ya da adı yanlış)
en: The file COPY asks for is not in the build context (or its name is wrong)
The image is not on Docker Hub

explanation.en: Look at the file name at the end of the error.

text.tr: Dockerfile'ın adı farklıysa (ör. Dockerfile.dev) nasıl gösterilir?
text.en: If the Dockerfile has a different name (e.g. Dockerfile.dev), how do you point to it?

explanation.en: f: file.

text.tr: Dockerfile'da uzun bir satır nasıl bölünür?
text.en: How is a long line split in a Dockerfile?

en: By putting `\` at the end of the line
By putting `;` at the end of the line

explanation.en: Docker joins the continuation lines.

text.en: How is a comment line written in a Dockerfile?

explanation.en: As in Python.

text.en: After `COPY app.py src/`, where is the file (WORKDIR /app)?

explanation.tr: Sonu `/` ile biten hedef klasör sayılıyor.
explanation.en: A destination ending with `/` counts as a folder.

text.en: What does `COPY src/ .` do?

tr: src'nin içindekileri doğrudan çalışma klasörüne döker; src klasörü gelmez
en: Pours the contents of src straight into the working folder; the src folder does not come
Copies the src folder as it is

explanation.en: To keep the folder, `COPY src/ ./src/`.

text.tr: `COPY` ile `ADD` arasında hangisi önerilir ve neden?
text.en: Which of `COPY` and `ADD` is recommended, and why?

tr: COPY; ADD arşivleri açmak gibi sürpriz davranışlar taşıyor
en: COPY; ADD carries surprising behaviours such as unpacking archives
They are the same, it does not matter

explanation.tr: ADD yalnızca bir arşivi açmak gerektiğinde.
explanation.en: ADD only when an archive needs unpacking.

text.tr: Docker derlemesinde pip'in "Running pip as the 'root' user" uyarısı ne demektir?
text.en: In a Docker build, what does pip's "Running pip as the 'root' user" warning mean?

tr: Paketler kök kullanıcıyla kuruluyor; konteynerde zararsız ama ileride root olmayan kullanıcı öğrenilecek
en: Packages are installed as the root user; harmless in the container, but a non-root user comes later

explanation.tr: Uyarı, hata değil; derleme devam ediyor.
explanation.en: A warning, not an error; the build continues.

text.tr: Dockerfile talimatlarını küçük harfle yazmak çalışır mı?
text.en: Does writing Dockerfile instructions in lower case work?

en: It works, but the habit is upper case

explanation.en: Upper case separates the instruction from its arguments.

text.tr: İskelette `COPY requirements.txt .` ile `COPY . .` neden ayrı satırlarda?
text.en: In the skeleton, why are `COPY requirements.txt .` and `COPY . .` on separate lines?

tr: Docker iki dosyayı aynı anda kopyalayamaz
en: For the build cache (the next section)
Docker cannot copy two files at once

explanation.tr: Kod değişince paketler yeniden kurulmasın diye.
explanation.en: So packages are not reinstalled when the code changes.
